name: delegate_to_agent
description: Start a cold local sub-agent for a self-contained task. ASYNCHRONOUS: returns task_id immediately. It cannot see this conversation; task must include all context. Fan out independent work, then Join required task_ids with get_delegation_status. For each distinct agent/profile mention, call once; pass profile_id for a profile. Replace admission_failed/admission_unknown explicitly, never continue_delegation.

profile_id.description: Optional immutable profile UUID; runs that profile without agent defaults.

profile_label.description: Display label for a profile mention; routing ignores it.

task.description: Complete prompt: goal, context, absolute paths, constraints, and expected output.

correlation_id.description: Fresh token for each invocation (UUID recommended); never reuse.

working_dir.description: Absolute working directory; defaults to the parent session directory.

work_unit_key.description: Optional orchestration key (≤200 chars) for recovery budgets and first-dispatch fencing.

replaces_task_id.description: Prior same-role terminal task_id when replacing (pair with replacement_reason).

replacement_reason.description: Required with replaces_task_id. admission_failed and admission_unknown: explicit replacement only (never continue).

name: continue_delegation
description: Continue a prior terminal child run on the same external session. ASYNCHRONOUS: returns a new task_id immediately. Provide prior task_id and full revision prompt. Never creates a new child; resume/load only. Join with get_delegation_status like delegate_to_agent.

task_id.description: Prior run task_id to continue (latest eligible terminal on its child).

task.description: Complete revision prompt with all context the child needs.

correlation_id.description: Fresh token for each invocation (UUID recommended); never reuse.

work_unit_key.description: Optional orchestration key; defaults to the prior run's key when omitted.

name: get_delegation_status
description: Get task_ids status/results in input order. Omit wait_ms for an immediate snapshot. Join via return_when=all_terminal_or_attention, wait_ms=0; positive wait_ms is rejected. Join returns when all requested tasks are terminal, attention is required, or unavailable. Answer attention, then re-Join only still-running required task_ids. Includes wake_reason and attention_requests.

name: cancel_delegation
description: Cancel a running task only when its result is no longer wanted. timeout is non-canceling and returns guidance to keep waiting. Prefer get_delegation_status with wait_ms for slow work. If already finished, return its final result.

reason.description: Reason: timeout is non-canceling; taskfail, usercancel, and others cancel.

name: check_user_feedback
description: Read pending messages; messages are available only through this tool. Non-blocking. Call before starting implementation, a significant decision, and after a meaningful sub-task. Treat them as HIGH-PRIORITY steering; empty result means continue.

name: ask_user_question
description: Render interactive cards for 1-4 related multiple-choice questions and BLOCK until submitted or dismissed. Use only for a genuinely user-owned discrete decision that cannot be resolved from the request, code, or sensible defaults. Do not ask merely whether to proceed, confirm an obvious default, or collect open-ended input. Other is added automatically. Put a recommended choice first and append ' (Recommended)' to its label. Prefer one call for related questions.

multiSelect.description: Whether multiple options may be selected.

label.description: Short choice text; append ' (Recommended)' to the first recommended choice.

description.description: Meaning or trade-off of this choice.

name: get_session_info
description: Resolve codeg://session/<number> to read-only metadata and optional recent messages. Use Codeg's internal conversation ID, not the agent session ID. Missing returns found: false, not an error.

session_id.description: Number from codeg://session/<number>; Codeg's internal conversation ID.

max_messages.description: Recent turns to include. Defaults to 20; 0 returns metadata only; max 200.

name: request_parent_decision
description: Ask the direct parent for a blocking decision. Blocks until reply or closure; not for progress, logs, or warnings.

name: reply_to_delegation
description: Reply to an open direct-child Join decision. First reply wins; same reply is idempotent.

name: get_workflow_state
description: Load durable workflow recovery state. Optional workflow_id.

name: publish_workflow_manifest
description: Publish/CAS v2 brainstorm_to_delivery; Rust validates nested fields.

name: settle_workflow_gate
description: Root-only Design/Plan gate settle with structured evidence.

evidence.description: kind=design: critical_count, important_count, minor_count. kind=plan: scope full/scoped; revision_kind initial/localized/material/holistic_rewrite; scope_reason; covered_author_task_id; covered_plan_digest; required_reviewer_node_ids; finding_updates of finding_id, severity, status, owner_reviewer_node_ids, summary, evidence_ref, report_file; optional lineage_reset_reason.
